author: D3troa
quote: The gaming is visually stunning but that's really the only thing it has going for it. The people who worked on this hate what GTA really is. This is not a game, this is not fun, this is the AAAAA equivalent of the stupid "random thing Simulators" that appear on Steam every week. And don't even get me started on the censorship, political correctness and change of tone from the past episodes. The saddest part is that people still love it. Video games became too mainstream and now it is dead. Good thing there are thousands of good old games to play.

author: D3troa
quote:
Game is beautiful, probably the best looking game on stock PS4. The animation are sometimes a little off and there are a few bugs here and there but overall, it's way ahead of most of the games on this subject.

Music are almost non existent which is a shame since the first game had some nice ones.

Gameplay isn't bad but it's very simple, just an updated copy of the gameplay from the first game which was OK in 2013 but already not memorable. The reason people still liked the first game is that the gameplay wasn't that important, what was important in TLOU was the writing, the story, the characters. And this is where it gets ugly.

One character aside, the cast is dull. You couldn't even describe the characters otherwise than by saying "it's that guy wearing a hat" or "it's that Asian looking guy". The characters aren't badly written, they're not written at all. Oh, my bad, Ellie is written : they gave her tons of hobbies to fill the void in the writing but it simply doesn't work. You can't be a good guitar player, song writer, astronomy expert, comics nerd, good drawing artist, hand to hand combat expert, pro sniper and bow shooter all at the same time. It's ridiculous and it doesn't make her more real, that's just pure failed writing. Also, the way she talks with Dina make them sound like they actually lived in the "old world" which is even more shocking since the fact she was so clueless on the subject in the first game was so evident in he conversation with Joel.

All the good ideas from the first game in terms of rhythm and storytelling, like the short and almost entirely playable introduction are gone. Now you have to endure long and useless scenes where you can only walk ALL THE TIME and the game takes forever to really start. Most important events are badly timed, they happen too soon or too late so they have almost no impact on what you feel. The game completely lacks that feeling from the first one where you feel like you're there, in the game, living the same adventure the characters do. Instead of that, it's like you're watching people you don't care about act from far away. Plus some scenes are so bad, so outdated, they feel like a Seinfeld episode in term of directing.

And what about that stupid idea of forcing you to play with the antagonist for HALF THE GAME. Yes, everyone understood why, it's so obvious you can't misunderstand it, that's not the issue, the issue is that it's a stupid idea. That's not what the players were told, they were all thinking that this game would be TLOU but with Ellie as a main character which is not the case. They lied to the players, pure and simple. On top of that, you can also add that the game is long for absolutely no reason (the story is so simple and the gameplay so limited, you want the game to end after like 10 hours) which makes this part of the game even more boring.

Let's not forget "the message" the game is trying to push on you. It's so obvious, so awkward, so contradicting, cringe and illogical, it simply doesn't make any sense, the writer obviously wanted to do something deep but failed to grasp the gist of it resulting in a really stupid conclusion.

The Last of Us is one of my favorite game ever. When the second one was announced, I tried very hard not to get my hopes up because I knew making a sequel at least as good as the first one would be difficult. I avoided all spoilers and drama but even with all these precaution, I've never been so disappointed by a game. This is a unexplainable and unforgivable waste.

I gave it 1 because I acknowledge all the hard work the 3D artists, devs and such put in the game but I can't give it more because TLOU2 is abysmal compared to the first one.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: D3troa
quote: This should have been a movie. The visuals are stunning, the atmosphere is awesome and the main story is interesting. Sadly, this isn't a movie, this is a video game and pretty much every single gameplay aspect is absolutely terrible. Going back and forth to the same places again and again doing nothing but delivering useless stuff to people with awfully written backgrounds is the most boring thing I've done in a video game since like forever. The vehicles collision handling is absolutely abysmal. The "multiplayer" aspect is also completely botched leading to people being able to pollute others' maps with  useless and ugly signs and constructions with no purpose absolutely everywhere. I think it's the first time such a bad game is getting such good reviews from journalists. Paid reviews ? Journalists not being on the same page as players ? I don't know but what I do know is that there's a real journalistic issue here.
